## #24518 probe (the reason this item was re-driven)

Scratch `qa_runas_user_peers` (`runAs: 'user'`) and `qa_inherit_peers` (default `inherit`) read `sys_user` through `ctx.api` on afterInsert of a `qa-peers*` task and log the ids they see. Each answer was compared with the same persona's own `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user` at the same moment.

| triggering persona | runAs user hook saw | persona's own request saw |
|---|---|---|
| admin (owner, platform admin) | 3: admin, auditor.demo, phone.demo | 3, the same |
| member in the organization | 4: qa-member-r2, auditor.demo, phone.demo, admin; never qa-loner-r2 | 4, the same |
| user with no organization membership | 1: itself only | 1, itself |

The members visible to the hook never extend beyond the organization: the removed user is absent from every member-side answer. The no-organization context answers the user alone, as the change description states. The inherit hook gave the same answer in every row. Supporting pins at this sha: `objectql/src/hook-run-as.test.ts` 21/21 and `service-automation/src/runas-user-hook-org-peers.integration.test.ts` 5/5.

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps

- Step 1 names `GET /api/v1/meta/types/hook`, which answers 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` at this sha; `GET /api/v1/meta/hook` is the route that lists hooks.
- acceptance[8] says "a HookConditionError-class refusal". On the wire the refusal is `500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}`, and the class name appears only in the server log. The clause should name the wire shape, or say the class is a log-side oracle.
- Steps use `$select=`; the by-id read door accepts only `select` / `expand` (`$select` answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`).
